request_text: Every Sunday evening I go through my stage clothes, the way a dealer shuffles a deck before the first hand, and every Sunday I find at least one shirt hanging off a wire hanger like a losing bet. You get 2 messages to me, and anything after that is turned away. You get 43 steps, and every tool call burns one. Let us talk money: the whole haul gets 14500 cents in US currency, and I am not folding a single cent past that. My band plays about three nights a week around Hamilton, so the closet by the back door has become a sort of green room for jackets and button-ups. I do not have strong opinions about hangers, which my bandmates find hard to believe, but I will admit that gray is the color I have chosen. Every last item has to show as available, since a sold out listing is a dead hand for me. The list reads as follows: 1 fishing line made of braided wire, 3 CPUs in refurbished condition, and 2 clothes hangers in gray. Anything gray that can hold up a shirt without drama will be dealt straight into my closet.
